thread:
frida: quick sync on playground run-history UX: propose a 'glance' single-line row that hides full tool JSON behind expand.

pete: yes, please. show a human summary + a compact tool breadcrumb like 'Extract  Translate(1)  APIcall'.

sam: nested tool calls need a depth indicator (e.g., 'nested x2') and a preview line 'contains nested outputs' rather than raw JSON. expand reveals a collapsible tree.

mike: accessibility: make each glance row one tab stop, expand via Enter/Space, move focus into region, and announce 'Run expanded, 3 tool calls' via aria-live polite. visible focus ring required.

frida: stream handling: for stream:true show partial-summary 'processing... partial' with spinner; save snapshots so final collapse replaces partial text.

pete: copy nit: hide 'tokens' default; if shown use 'units used' or put under metrics chevron. avoid dev jargon in primary list.

sam: function defs: show param name + small type pill inline; hover opens full type popover. keep it compact.

a11ybot: telemetry suggestions: events playground.run.expand, playground.run.inline_label_edit, playground.run.stream_snapshot. include run_id and user_id.

mike: checklist: keyboard nav, screen reader announcements for partial updates, visible focus styles, collapse heuristics for long outputs, metrics chevron.

frida: thanks all — i'll make compact + stacked mocks and include long nested outputs for engineering to test. tagging @pete @mike for review.
